About Women’s Hormonal Balance & Endocrine Therapy

This Ayurvedic hormonal balance treatment aims to restore hormonal balance and enhance the well-being of the endocrine system by applying Ayurvedic principles. Aimed at tackling issues such as PCOS, thyroid imbalance, menopause signs, menstrual inconsistencies, and emotional changes, the therapy initiates with a comprehensive Ayurvedic consultation to evaluate doshic imbalances. The hormonal imbalance therapy for women comprises targeted Panchakarma therapies, medicated oil massages, herbal remedies, yoga, and pranayama practices. A sattvic diet, guided meditation, and lifestyle guidance additionally aid in endocrine revitalization.

Situated within Kerala’s rejuvenating greenery, the holistic hormonal balance program supports women in reclaiming balance, energy, emotional health, and natural rhythm—softly and entirely.
